title: The Decentralization Tax
description: Cost per million tokens and throughput for Llama 3.3 70B on 8x H100 as the batch fills. A single-tenant node (B=1) runs ~25 tok/s at ~$258/M; a filled batch (B=256) runs ~2,800 tok/s at ~$2.30/M — same silicon, 112x cheaper. Pick a batch; read the tax you pay for the GPU you can't fill.
controls: tap a batch chip to set the operating point
click the chart to snap to the nearest measured batch
arrow keys to step through batch sizes
